map.家具质量等级评估（标准/检测）使用指南: Furniture Quality & Safety Compliance Checker User Guide
map.家具质量评估先把甲醛释放量、加载力、耐久次数、稳定性四项逐项填全，再按统一演示阈: Fill in all four items — formaldehyde emission, load force, durability cycles and stability — then check the uniform demo thresholds for “all passed / one or more failed”. Results are for internal screening only; they do not replace current standard clauses, test methods or a third-party report.
map.四项检测值逐项必填，缺项直接提示补填: All four values are required; missing fields are flagged
map.按木家具、金属家具、软体家具提示参考标准: Reference standards by furniture type: wooden, metal or upholstered
map.甲醛 E0/E1 只作档位提示，不认证整件家具: E0/E1 are formaldehyde band hints only and do not certify the whole item
map.采购前把检测报告数值录入，快速核对是否有缺项或明显不达标: Before purchase, enter report values to check for missing items or obvious failures
map.品控内部初筛，决定是否送第三方检测或补充试验: Internal QC screening before deciding on third-party testing or extra trials
map.区分“演示阈值通过”和“标准认证通过”，避免误读: Separate “demo thresholds passed” from “standard certification passed”
map.选择家具类型，页面提示对应参考标准（木 GB/T 3324、金属 GB/T 33: Choose the furniture type; the page shows the reference standard (wood GB/T 3324, metal GB/T 3325, upholstered QB/T 1952.1).
map.填写甲醛释放量（0–10 mg/L）、加载力（≥0 N）、耐久次数（非负整数）、: Enter formaldehyde (0–10 mg/L), load force (≥0 N), durability cycles (non-negative integer) and stability (0–5).
map.四项都填完后查看“演示判定”：全部达到阈值才显示“全部通过（非标准认证）”，否则: After all four are filled, read the demo verdict: only all thresholds met shows “all passed (not a standard certification)”; otherwise “one or more items failed”.
map.把结果与检测报告、标准条款逐条对照；需要认证时另行送检。: Compare the result with the report and standard clauses item by item; arrange separate testing if certification is needed.
map.耐久次数必须是整数，0 次会被判为不达标，不再被默认成 1 次。: Durability cycles must be an integer; 0 is a failure and is no longer defaulted to 1.
map.甲醛 ≤0.5 mg/L 提示 E0 档、≤1.5 mg/L 提示 E1 档，但: Formaldehyde ≤0.5 mg/L suggests E0 and ≤1.5 mg/L suggests E1, but compliance also depends on the other three items and the report.
map.稳定性阈值 0.10 是演示门槛；儿童家具、公共场所家具可能另有更严要求。: The 0.10 stability threshold is a demo gate; children’s or public-space furniture may have stricter requirements.
map.负值、超出范围或非有限数值会被直接拒绝，不会带着脏数据出结论。: Negative, out-of-range or non-finite values are rejected instead of producing a conclusion from bad data.
map.四项里只填甲醛和加载力能判合格吗？: Can I judge compliance with only formaldehyde and load force?
map.不能。四项必须逐项填写，耐久次数与稳定性缺项时直接提示补填；只有四项都达到演示阈: No. All four items must be filled; missing durability or stability triggers a prompt, and only all four meeting the demo thresholds shows “all passed”.
map.E0/E1 代表整件家具已认证吗？: Do E0/E1 mean the whole furniture item is certified?
map.不代表。E0/E1 只是甲醛释放量档位提示，整件家具判定还涉及标准条款、试验方法: No. E0/E1 are formaldehyde band hints only; a full judgement also involves standard clauses, test methods, sampling and a report. This page only demonstrates input checking.
